report.root_cause: The robot lacks sufficient orientation and height stabilization because the balance_assist_scale is set below the required threshold for the policy to maintain its posture.
evidence: pelvis_normal_height steadily declined from 0.635 at step 5 to 0.418 at step 126
upright_score dropped from 0.962 at step 5 to 0.841 at step 126
pelvis_normal_height fell below the failure threshold of 0.42m at step 126
report.issue_title: Pelvis height collapse due to insufficient balance assist
report.expected_after_fix: The robot will maintain a pelvis height above 0.42m by utilizing the full orientation PD and lateral spring gains.
